response.justification: Despite extensive senior-level experience, the candidate lacks junior-level alignment: Java is only listed as a skill without project context, German is only basic (not meeting required fluency), and the resume reflects a senior/lead profile unsuitable for an entry-level role, with no evidence of being an agile team member in insurance-sector projects.
strengths: Extensive full-stack experience across multiple languages and platforms
Strong open-source contributions and technical communication skills
Demonstrated expertise in testing, CI/CD, and agile practices
concerns: German language proficiency is only basic, not meeting job requirement
Overqualified with 10+ years of senior experience, misaligned with entry-level role
No visible Java projects or insurance-sector experience despite Java being required
